int_name: S SAINT BERNARD ST & WARRINGTON AVE

result.summary: The image shows a residential street corner with sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible, and parked cars obstruct sightlines at the corner.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: No designated crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb, creating a barrier for those with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the corner block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility between all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row housing and a sidewalk, but it lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. Parked vehicles along the curb create significant visual obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely, increasing exposure risk.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians attempting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

result.summary: This residential intersection features sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks and visible traffic control devices. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corners create an environment where pedestrians must negotiate crossings without dedicated protection or clear sightlines.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
